title: 第4章 沈家刀 八步赶蝉
slug: 穿梭时空的侠客全本免费-穿梭时空的侠客最新章节列表
content_zh:
“这种运动在西洋是一种很普遍的训练方式，只要看上一眼就能看明白！”陈浩有些愕然，你这是侮辱哥们的智商啊！连几岁的小孩子都懂俯卧撑之类的运动好不好！
沈炼不是普通人，他可是绣春刀世界里的顶尖高手，身手和眼界远不是陈浩能比的。
在他看来俯卧撑之类的动作虽看似简单，但对于初练武功的新人却是能起到不小的助益，对他这种级别的高手就没有什么辅助效果了。
沈炼见陈浩回答的简单，还以为陈浩是有意敷衍不想提及他的隐秘，遂不再多问。
其实沈炼是个很冷酷且自我的人，如果是别人他都懒得问，可眼前之人是他的堂弟，是他唯一的亲人了！
“昨天过招我发现你的反应能力尚可，只是身体过于单薄，否则也不会被我一招打晕！”沈炼转移话题说道。
陈浩听明白了沈炼的意思，摆明了是要指点他，他本就想跟沈炼学习武功，连忙顺着杆子往上爬，他双手抱拳道：“还请大哥指教。”
沈炼若轻叹了一声，道：“我本来是打算让你辞掉职务去做生意的，咱们这些锦衣卫干的就是得罪人的事情，被人打击报复是常事，就算是历代指挥使又有几人能得善终，可笑那些人还花钱找门路进锦衣卫，要知道眼下时局动荡，稍不留神就可能身首异处，死都不知道怎么死的，你去做生意最起码还能为我们沈家留下一条血脉，而你本身就羸弱不堪也不是做锦衣卫的料！”
说到这里，沈炼停顿了一下，然后又道：“不过当我看到你嗜血般的眼神时，我又改变了对你的看法，我觉得一个人不管天赋实力如何，不服输的精神才是做人的根本，而你拥有这种精神！”
沈炼能说出这种富含至理的话还真是出乎陈浩的意料，绣春刀电影中的沈炼自私愚钝，第一部为了赎周妙彤收受魏忠贤的贿赂，间接害死了大哥三弟，修罗战场又为了救北斋惹下大祸被东厂锦衣卫联合追杀，关键是这两个女人都不爱他，他的所作所为在陈浩看来实在是愚不可及。
直到真实走进沈炼这个人，陈浩才发现自己对这人的理解太片面了，谁又能说此人不是大智若愚呢！
可能他知道身处在这阴暗的社会中无力改变现状，从而选择了随波逐流一头扎进命运的泥潭中。
同时陈浩也明白了原主人为何没能在电影中出现，可能是接受了沈炼的安排，退出锦衣卫去做了一份养家糊口的小生意。
“你想跟我学咱们沈家的武功吗？”沈炼又问道。
陈浩心里顿时乐开了花，他连忙道：“还请大哥传授小弟家学武功。”
“哦！”沈炼突然直视陈浩的双眼，好像要将他彻底看透，看了一会他才说道：“想要练武必然会经受常人难以忍受的苦痛，冬练三九夏练三伏，只有经过坚持不懈的努力，才能练就一身好武艺，你有一颗不服输的心，但你能吃得了这种苦吗？”
“吃得苦中苦，方为人上人，这点苦我还吃得消！”面对沈炼慑人的眼神陈浩毫不在意，他抬头挺胸平静的与其对视。
沈炼欣慰的点了点头，道：“我不知道你跟什么人学过武功，但你身体羸弱是不争的事实，所以我决定先锻炼你的身体。”
“那就请大哥尽情的蹂躏吧！”陈浩故意摆出一副小生怕怕的表情。
“臭小子！”见堂弟搞怪，沈炼笑着捶了下陈浩的胸膛，当然比第一次捶打要轻得多......

见沈炼发笑，陈浩明白沈炼终于接受了他这个堂弟，至少不会再去板着脸和其说话了！
两兄弟以前的感情很好，原主人又是性格洒脱的脾性，时常能将冷淡严峻的沈炼给逗笑。
“呦呵，大哥还会笑啊，我还以为大哥会一直都会板着脸来着！”陈浩调侃道，那语气仿佛要将之前受得气都给补回来。
“好了，好了，都是大哥的错，大哥不是见你不争气嘛！既然你决定以后苦练武功，那大哥给你道歉！”沈炼无奈道，心说早知道不惹这位小祖宗了！
沈炼的脑海中不断浮现出小时候的画面，十年前叔父沈一高还未去广州，那时候祖父也还未去世，他们两家还在一起居住，堂弟少时调皮捣蛋，经常与其他小孩发生争执，一旦打不过的时候就找他帮忙，等人家的大人找上门来，堂弟就把事情推到他身上，挨打背锅的总是他沈炼！

content_en:
"This kind of exercise is a very common training method in the West. You can understand it just by looking at it!" Chen Hao was a little stunned. You are insulting my brother's IQ! Even children of a few years old know how to do exercises like push-ups!
Shen Lian is not an ordinary person. He is a top master in the world of Xiuchundao. His skill and vision are far beyond what Chen Hao can compare with.
In his opinion, although push-ups and other movements may seem simple, they can be of great help to newcomers who are just starting to practice martial arts, but they have no auxiliary effect on masters of his level.
Seeing Chen Hao's simple answer, Shen Lian thought that Chen Hao was deliberately perfunctory and did not want to mention his secret, so he stopped asking any more questions.
In fact, Shen Lian is a very cold and self-centered person. He wouldn't bother to ask if it was anyone else, but the person in front of him is his cousin and his only relative!
"I found out during yesterday's attack that your reaction ability is acceptable, but your body is too thin, otherwise you wouldn't be knocked unconscious by my attack!" Shen Lian said, changing the subject.
Chen Hao understood what Shen Lian meant and made it clear that he wanted to give him some advice. He originally wanted to learn martial arts from Shen Lian, so he quickly climbed up the pole. He clasped his fists with both hands and said, "Please give me some advice, big brother."
Shen Lianruo sighed softly and said: "I originally planned to let you resign from your position and go into business. What we Jinyiwei do is to offend people. It is common for us to be retaliated by others. Even if there are many commanders in the past who have died a good death, it is ridiculous that those people still spend time. Qian is looking for a way to enter Jinyiwei. You must know that the current situation is turbulent. If you are not careful, you may die without knowing how. If you go into business, you can at least leave a bloodline for our Shen family, and you are not suitable for being Jinyiwei!"
Having said this, Shen Lian paused for a moment, and then said: "But when I saw your bloodthirsty eyes, I changed my view on you. I think that no matter how talented a person is, the spirit of not admitting defeat is the foundation of being a human being, and you have this spirit!"
Chen Hao was really surprised that Shen Lian could say such wise words. Shen Lian in the Xiuchundao movie was selfish and dull. In the first movie, he accepted Wei Zhongxian's bribe to redeem Zhou Miaotong, and indirectly killed his eldest brother and his third brother. In Shura battlefield, he caused a big disaster to save Beizhai and was hunted down by the Dongchang Jinyiwei. The key is that neither of these women loved him. What he did was really stupid in Chen Hao's opinion.
It wasn't until he really got to know Shen Lian that Chen Hao realized that his understanding of this person was too one-sided. Who can say that this person is not a wise man but a fool!
Maybe he knew that he was unable to change the status quo in this gloomy society, so he chose to follow the trend and plunge into the quagmire of fate.
At the same time, Chen Hao also understood why the original owner failed to appear in the movie. He may have accepted Shen Lian's arrangement and quit Jinyiwei to start a small business to support his family.
"Do you want to learn our Shen family's martial arts from me?" Shen Lian asked again.
Chen Hao suddenly felt happy, and he quickly said: "Please also ask the elder brother to teach the younger brother the martial arts at home."
"Oh!" Shen Lian suddenly looked directly into Chen Hao's eyes, as if he wanted to see him through. After looking at him for a while, he said: "If you want to practice martial arts, you will inevitably endure unbearable pain. Practice in winter and practice in summer. Only through unremitting efforts can you develop good martial arts. You have a heart that refuses to admit defeat, but can you endure this kind of suffering?"
"You have to endure hardships to become a master. I can bear this little hardship!" Chen Hao didn't care about Shen Lian's intimidating eyes. He raised his head and straightened his chest and looked at her calmly.
Shen Lian nodded happily and said, "I don't know who you have learned martial arts from, but it is an indisputable fact that your body is weak, so I decided to exercise your body first."
"Then please let me ravage you, big brother!" Chen Hao deliberately put on a scared expression.
"You brat!" Shen Lian laughed when he saw his cousin acting strangely.Then he hit Chen Hao's chest, which was of course much lighter than the first time...
Seeing Shen Lian laughing, Chen Hao understood that Shen Lian had finally accepted him as his cousin, and at least he would not talk to him with a straight face anymore!
The two brothers had a good relationship before, and the original owner had a free and easy temperament, and could often make the cold and serious Shen Lian laugh.
"Hey, brother can still laugh. I thought he would always have a straight face!" Chen Hao joked, his tone seemed to make up for the anger he had suffered before.
"Okay, okay, it's all brother's fault. Didn't you see that you didn't live up to expectations? Since you decided to practice martial arts hard in the future, I will apologize to you!" Shen Lian said helplessly, thinking that he would have known better not to offend this little ancestor!
Images from his childhood kept popping up in Shen Lian's mind. Ten years ago, his uncle Shen Yigao had not gone to Guangzhou, and his grandfather had not passed away at that time. The two families were still living together. When he was young, his cousin was naughty and often had disputes with other children. When he couldn't fight, he would ask him for help. When the adults came to the door, his cousin would blame it on him, and it was always Shen Lian who took the blame!
